REFERRAL LETTER
Date: 10/03/2026
Patient Name: Daniel Avery
DOB: 05/03/1950
MRN: MRN-98881

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. Grant Avery, Jasper Family Practice

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of intermittent palpitations in a patient with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.

Daniel Avery is a 76-year-old man with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, hypertension, and hypothyroidism. Over the past month, he has had episodes of a fast, irregular heartbeat several times per week. They last a few minutes and resolve on their own. He denies chest discomfort or fainting.

Please evaluate his intermittent palpitations in the setting of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Grant Avery
Jasper Family Practice

3. Hypothyroidism. Continue routine management and follow-up.
